title: abc Conjecture
subtitle: Unsolved problem
summary: For coprime a+b=c, the radical rad(abc) is almost always larger than c.
detail:
\[c<\operatorname{rad}(abc)^{1+\varepsilon}\text{ for all }\varepsilon>0\text{ (finitely many exceptions)}\]

Implies Fermat's Last Theorem and many other results. Mochizuki claims a proof (2012), but the mathematical community has not reached consensus.
